name: VOCAL_KEY_OPTIMIZER

required_inputs.melody: Original melody note events: MIDI pitch, onset, duration, lyric vowel, section, register intention
required_inputs.voice: Consented comfortable phrase takes, sustained tessitura, register behavior, effort, diction and repeatability
required_inputs.reference: Version-bound tonic/mode, interval contour envelope and beat unit; not copied protected melody

algorithm: Select a comfortable baseline key with Nitin and Vatsal.
Enumerate integer semitone shifts only within demonstrated comfortable limits. For every note, new_midi = original_midi + shift; tonic = (original_tonic + shift) mod 12.
Preserve intervals and mode under uniform transposition. Calculate duration-weighted pitch distribution by verse/chorus/climax, not merely min/max.
Check sustained demands, phrase endings, register transitions, vowel clarity, breath and repeated performance; range endpoints alone do not determine fit.
Audition a small number of nearby keys at comparable gain and tempo with rests; stop an uncomfortable take. Repeat the favored key on another occasion.
Select creative fit by listening with Nitin; instrument tone and arrangement may need adaptation after transposition.
prohibited_shortcuts: No population hit key as Nitin target
No fixed safe semitone offset for all voices
No numerical fit without observations and an explicitly defined scoring protocol
pitch_invariants: Equal semitone shift preserves all pairwise intervals
Octave rewrites and mode changes require separate arrangement decisions
